title: Retrievers Module
summary: The retrievers module provides tools for efficient document retrieval, offering various strategies to fetch relevant information from diverse sources based on a given query. It includes components for semantic similarity, maximal marginal relevance, multi-query generation, and document compression.

nodes.label: BaseRetriever
nodes.title: Base Retriever
nodes.description: Abstract base class for all retrieval systems, defining the core interface for fetching relevant documents based on a query. It supports both synchronous and asynchronous operations.

nodes.label: SemanticSimilarityExampleSelector
nodes.title: Semantic Similarity Example Selector
nodes.description: Selects examples based on their semantic similarity to a given input, leveraging vector stores for efficient nearest-neighbor search.

nodes.label: MaxMarginalRelevanceExampleSelector
nodes.title: Max Marginal Relevance Example Selector
nodes.description: Selects examples using Max Marginal Relevance (MMR) to ensure diversity among the retrieved examples while maintaining relevance to the query.

nodes.label: LLMChainExtractor
nodes.title: LLM Chain Extractor
nodes.description: Compresses documents by using an LLM chain to extract only the most relevant parts of the document content based on a query.

nodes.label: LLMChainFilter
nodes.title: LLM Chain Filter
nodes.description: Filters documents by using an LLM chain to determine their relevance to a query, dropping irrelevant documents from the result set.

nodes.label: CohereRerank
nodes.title: Cohere Rerank
nodes.description: Utilizes the Cohere Rerank API to reorder documents based on their relevance to a query, improving the quality of retrieved results.

nodes.label: EnsembleRetriever
nodes.title: Ensemble Retriever
nodes.description: Combines multiple retrievers and applies a rank fusion algorithm (e.g., Reciprocal Rank Fusion) to aggregate and re-rank their results, enhancing overall retrieval performance.

nodes.label: MultiQueryRetriever
nodes.title: Multi-Query Retriever
nodes.description: Generates multiple variations of a single query using an LLM, then retrieves documents for each variation and combines the unique results.

nodes.label: MultiVectorRetriever
nodes.title: Multi-Vector Retriever
nodes.description: Retrieves parent documents by searching over smaller, embedded child chunks, ensuring that full document context is returned even when searching granular data.

nodes.label: SelfQueryRetriever
nodes.title: Self-Query Retriever
nodes.description: Uses an LLM to construct structured queries for a vector store, allowing for more complex and nuanced retrieval based on natural language inputs.

nodes.label: ExaSearchRetriever
nodes.title: Exa Search Retriever
nodes.description: Integrates with the Exa Search API to perform web searches and retrieve relevant documents, supporting various filtering and content options.

nodes.label: PerplexitySearchRetriever
nodes.title: Perplexity Search Retriever
nodes.description: Leverages the Perplexity Search API to fetch web search results, offering parameters for result count, token limits, and domain/date filtering.

nodes.label: VectorStore
nodes.title: Vector Store
nodes.description: An external component representing a vector database used for storing and querying embeddings, crucial for semantic search operations.

nodes.label: LLM
nodes.title: Large Language Model
nodes.description: An external component representing a Large Language Model, used for generating queries, extracting information, or filtering documents.

nodes.label: Embeddings
nodes.title: Embeddings
nodes.description: An external component responsible for generating vector representations of text, used by vector stores for similarity calculations.

nodes.label: ByteStore
nodes.title: Byte Store
nodes.description: An external component for low-level storage of bytes, used by MultiVectorRetriever to store parent documents.

nodes.label: Cohere API
nodes.title: Cohere API
nodes.description: An external API service provided by Cohere, used for advanced text processing tasks like re-ranking documents based on relevance.

nodes.label: Exa API
nodes.title: Exa API
nodes.description: An external API service provided by Exa, used for web search and content retrieval.

nodes.label: Perplexity API
nodes.title: Perplexity API
nodes.description: An external API service provided by Perplexity, used for web search and content retrieval with various filtering options.

groups.label: Core Retrieval Mechanisms
groups.title: Core Retrieval Mechanisms
groups.description: Fundamental components for defining and executing document retrieval strategies, including base classes and common retrieval patterns.

groups.label: Document Processing & Optimization
groups.title: Document Processing and Optimization
groups.description: Components focused on refining and optimizing retrieved documents, including extraction, filtering, and re-ranking techniques.

groups.label: Example Selection Strategies
groups.title: Example Selection Strategies
groups.description: Components for dynamically selecting relevant examples based on semantic similarity or maximal marginal relevance to improve prompt engineering.

groups.label: External Search Integrations
groups.title: External Search Integrations
groups.description: Components that integrate with third-party search APIs to expand retrieval capabilities beyond internal data sources.
